authority: Owner-approved amendment supplement to the canonical Decision Ledger; preserve unrelated Locked decisions.

decisions.approval: Owner requests all badge colors in both modes match the old app dark mode, using the project JSX rather than visual approximations.
decisions.decision: Use exact dark-mode fill and lettering colors from dial-in-collective.jsx for Dialed In and all five shot styles in both themes. Keep the newer defined borders, layout and typography. Apply the original dark taste ramp consistently.
decisions.new_status_mapping: Pending/Conflict/Pending Sync use original dark gold; there is no direct JSX badge counterpart. Borders are the retained review treatment, not copied legacy borders.
decisions.implementation_status: Staged on the isolated visual-review branch; screenshot approval and full review remain pending.
decisions.release_hold: No Netlify deployment until owner approves the next consolidated release; no changes to live access controls, data or account permissions.
